observable.name: tracer_diffusivity
observable.definition: Short-time translational diffusion coefficient of dilute tracer spheres in the sample, read from the mean squared displacement of tracked centroids over lag times below the trap-free drift time.

targets.note: Stated by the person on 2026-09-20, answering A6's lateral_resolution abstention. KIND IS THE NEAREST OF THREE AND NOT A FIT: the enum offers uncertainty, decade_resolution and detection, and a required RESOLUTION -- two things this far apart must be distinguishable -- is none of them exactly. `detection` is chosen because it is the only one that reads as a threshold that must be reached. Raised with manager-microscope, who owns the enum. AND EXPECT A REFUSAL RATHER THAN A BOUND. At NA 1.45 with the red path's passband centred near 595 nm the diffraction limit is about 205 nm, so 100 nm is not reachable on this instrument and A6 should say so outright. That is a valid outcome (4.5.6) and it is written as stated rather than softened: a requirement this axis edits is not the person's requirement. If what was meant is how finely a single particle's CENTRE must be located, that is localisation_error and a different quantity -- the question is asked, not assumed.

Re-pinned from kbv-9bc3910f1886 to kbv-49feb73662b7 on 2026-09-18 (task 002). The tau_d near-miss for tracer_radius was re-read against the re-filed entry and the verdict does not move -- but neither of its reasons is the old one. It is no_overlap now because the entry carries no machine-readable validity, which kb_entry.schema.json makes no_overlap rather than a silent match; and because the relation reversed direction. Filed as a dimensionless group, tau_d was unrelated to a length. Filed as a derived_quantity in seconds over bead_diameter**2/diffusivity, it names this gap's own target as an input: it does not partially answer tracer_radius, it consumes it. Inverting it to d = sqrt(tau_d*D) yields nothing, because the store holds no tau_d value and D is this question's observable. So the gap is upstream of the entry rather than adjacent to it, and that is the finding: closing tracer_geometry with a lot number does not just raise the diameter to E3, it makes tau_d computable.

numbers.name: target_decade_resolution
numbers.note: one decade is enough to tell whether the tracers are free or hindered

numbers.name: tracer_diameter
numbers.note: Nominal diameter of the main species, which 5.3 rule 5 makes the reference length. Nominal is what the operator stated and all that is claimed: no polydispersity figure exists here, so no distribution is asserted, and one significant figure is the whole of it. A lot number would make this spec: at E3; there is none yet.

assumptions.statement: Screening only needs to place the diffusivity within one decade; the question is which regime the sample is in, not what the coefficient is.
assumptions.falsifier: if two candidate regimes fall inside the same decade, one decade is not enough and the goal must be restated

assumptions.statement: A centroid fit needs a signal to noise ratio of order five to keep the localisation error below a pixel; no measurement on this sample exists yet.
assumptions.falsifier: a localisation error above one pixel at this signal to noise ratio retires the assumption
